title: On Improvements of the Microscope with the aid of New Kinds of Optical Glass
version: Journal of the Royal Microscopical Society 7(1), pp. 20–34; author-revised translation of German report presented 9 July 1886; London reading 13 October 1886. Full journal OCR cached from Internet Archive.
lineage: Participant/designer’s primary explanation, translated and revised by the author. Independent performance claims are bounded by Dallinger’s tests; missing recipes are not supplied from later lore.
